theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_pf_imrep_carrier_mass_support
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), (∀ (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), R.Represents Y → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ Y.support) = 0 ∧ Y.mass = R.measure univ ∧ (IsCompact Y.support → R.measure univ ≠ ∞)) ∧ ∀ Y₁ Y₂ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, IsClosed Y₁.support ∧ (Y₁ - Y₂).support ⊆ Y₁.support ∪ Y₂.support
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
